(Currently Amended) A system for treating obesity, the system comprising: a gastric space filler comprising a first balloon connected to a second balloon by a conduit, wherein the gastric space filler is configured to occupy a substantial volume of a gastric cavity in the human patient in an inflated state; and an instrument throughput channel extending through the conduit, wherein the instrument throughput channel is configured to receive instruments, and further wherein the instrument throughput channel extends along an axial length of the conduit.

(Currently Amended) The system of claim 35 wherein in the first and second balloons are made from a flexible biocompatible material selected from the group consisting of silicone, latex, polyethylene, polyurethane, and nylon. 

(Currently Amended) The system of claim 34 wherein the gastric space filler further comprises a coupling mechanism configured for engagement with a retrieval device for removal of the gastric space filler from the gastric cavity. 

(Currently Amended) The system of claim 41, further comprising a delivery catheter configured to deliver the gastric space filler to the gastric cavity via an esophagus of the patient, wherein the delivery catheter is configured to receive the gastric space filler in a collapsed state. 

(Currently Amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42, further comprising a coupling mechanism at the first end of the conduit, wherein the coupling mechanism is configured to couple to a delivery catheter and/or a filling tube for instrument throughput into the third lumen.
